ppo_short.scope: 32 environments; 32 steps x 6 updates; 2 warmup; 4 measured real learning updates / 34 minibatches / 4096 decisions each. All seats remain learner; no recent/wide training-speed claim.
ppo_short.raw_timing_boundary: Measured update() wall time including collection, learning and inside-update verification; excludes initialization, warmup and post-update verification. Subtracting measured verification wall still leaves instrumentation effects.
